objective: Review the parser-payload required-field validation definition for the non-executing direct command-path fixture before allowing implementation, while keeping sidecar-plan materialization, direct command execution, timing, arbitrary filelist support, automatic allocation, runtime/ABI change, and raw full-state equality out of scope.

review_decision.reason: The definition targets the actual accepted gap in the direct command-path fixture: argv input already passes through the parser-stub fixture, but hand-built parser_payload input can currently omit reviewed parser-owned identity and build-input fields before reference-only boundary metadata is returned. Requiring the exact parser-stub handoff keyset is the smallest strict boundary that prevents schema drift, missing mdir/top_module, missing schema_version/surface, and unknown payload fields from being mistaken for reviewed native-parser handoff input.
review_decision.weakest_point: Exact parser-stub keyset validation is deliberately rigid: future parser-stub schema growth will require another gate or review rather than being silently accepted. The implementation file is also already at the 250-line script guard, so the next implementation must either shrink existing code or split reusable validation cleanly instead of adding large inline logic.

must_reject_before_boundary_metadata: unknown parser_payload keys outside the parser-stub handoff keyset
bool, zero, negative, or non-int state_count and step_count
shape mismatch after strict positive-int validation
missing, empty, null, or non-string mdir and top_module
non-list or non-string entries in preserved build-input lists
any sidecar-owned field prepopulated by parser_payload
missing explicit sidecar_context target, mode, template_or_target_registry_entry, or source_gate_or_manifest_ref
validation_order: validate exact parser-stub handoff keyset and required values
validate strict state_count, step_count, and shape
validate preserved build-input fields and provenance fields
only then return reference-only sidecar_plan_boundary metadata

accepted_parser_provenance_classificatio.source_boundary_status: parser-stub provenance that source closure is preserved only, not resolved
accepted_parser_provenance_classificatio.state_and_report_naming_rules: parser-stub provenance only, not sidecar-owned state/report materialization
accepted_parser_provenance_classificatio.non_claims: parser-stub provenance field, not an execution or compare authority
accepted_parser_provenance_classificatio.correctness_policy: later sidecar compare policy reference, not direct fixture compare evidence

required_next_implementation.name: implement_verilator_native_option_parser_direct_command_path_fixture_payload_validation_hardening_gate
must_implement: validate parser_payload against the parser-stub handoff keyset before copying it into output
reject missing schema_version, surface, source_boundary_status, state_and_report_naming_rules, correctness_policy, non_claims, mdir, and top_module before sidecar_plan_boundary metadata is returned
reject unknown non-sidecar parser_payload keys rather than preserving them silently
reject bool state_count or step_count before shape comparison can rely on True == 1
validate preserved build-input lists as list[str]
preserve existing argv path behavior for the accepted expanded sidecar-gpu 64x1 case
preserve existing direct fixture rejection layer and error structure
preserve all execution, measurement, timing, runtime/ABI, source-closure, filelist-expansion, and automatic-allocation flags as false
must_test: missing schema_version rejects before sidecar_plan_boundary metadata
missing or mismatched surface rejects before sidecar_plan_boundary metadata
missing mdir and missing top_module reject before parser_preserved_build_inputs are returned
bool state_count and bool step_count reject before shape comparison

sidecar-owned parser_payload fields still reject first
valid parser-stub payload from expanded argv still returns reference-only boundary metadata
must_not_do: claim complete native Verilator parser support

non_claims: not native Verilator parser implementation completion
not coverage-output equivalence for a direct native-parser flow
not source-closure or filelist dependency inference
not automatic optimal GPU allocation for any design
reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
